subject.title: improve(diagnostics-otel): make agent-duration histograms usable beyond 10s

question: Should OpenClaw land this narrower run/harness/context bucket policy, prefer the broader duration-histogram policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97098, or pause until exported metric defaults are settled?
rationale: Both branches intentionally change existing exported metric bucket layouts, and green CI cannot decide operator dashboard compatibility or the intended default bucket policy.

options.title: Choose one policy after proof
options.body: Require redacted real OTel export proof, then land either this focused three-histogram policy or the broader related policy as the maintained default.

options.title: Accept this narrow change
options.body: Merge this PR after confirming that only run, harness, and context buckets should change and that the dashboard compatibility impact is acceptable.

options.title: Pause for diagnostics policy
options.body: Keep both PRs open until the diagnostics owner decides the canonical duration and token bucket ranges.

recommendation.title: Choose one policy after proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted real OTel export proof, then land either this focused three-histogram policy or the broader related policy as the maintained default.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent history on diagnostics-otel metric behavior and OpenTelemetry migration work.
